name: pelham-hills-golf
description: Pelham Hills Golf Club - GPS Course Management & Live Scoring

scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:backend: echo 'Backend is Python-based, no build step required'
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=frontend && python -m flake8 backend/
scripts.format: npm run format:frontend && python -m black backend/
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --workspace=frontend && cd backend && python -m mypy backend/
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:frontend && npm run deploy:backend
scripts.deploy:tiles: npm run generate-tiles && npm run upload-r2
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules frontend/node_modules backend/.venv .next dist build *.log
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=frontend && pip install -r backend/requirements.txt

author: Pelham Hills Golf Club
